name: m4-symops-branch
description: Which commit of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199) moves `SymbolOpsBenchmark`, the omnibus workload: `findMember`, `overridingPairs`, `subst` × 16 and `erasure` × 5 in turn, repeated so each takes a similar share of the op, over the classes of a scala corpus compile done in setup. The range is the PR's source commits without the survey commits, whose trees match in `src`.
On the M4, 1 round, no profiler, so one fork per commit: a guide to large steps, not intervals. Release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap.
